subject: Mentor microgrant allocation for Modular AI sprint
content:
From: Lina Torres <lina@modularai.org>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Modular AI sprint — mentor microgrant request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the intro at KubeCon — Modular AI Collective is running a modular-models sprint on Sept 10-12 and we wanted to ask if Redwood can support mentor microgrants for community volunteers.

Quick background: we expect ~40 contributor teams, and we plan to run a 10-person mentor roster providing hands-on help for model onboarding and inference optimizations. The ask is for 10 mentor microgrants of $200 each (to be paid to mentors or community leads) plus a small compute voucher pool to be distributed to maintainers who need extra capacity for demos (~$600 total). Attached is the sprint grant form and a short budget.

Would Redwood consider approving this as a community credit? Our goals are: reduce friction for maintainers, surface Redwood to early-stage contributors, and collect a short case study post-event. Happy to provide more detail.

Best,
Lina
Lina Torres
Program Director, Modular AI Collective
[Attachment: MODAI_Sprint_Grant_Form.pdf (application form)]
[Attachment: mentor-budget-breakdown.xlsx]

-----
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Torres <lina@modularai.org>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Modular AI sprint — mentor microgrant request

Hi Lina — really excited about this. Quick follow-up Qs:
- Can you confirm mentors are individual volunteers (not org-sponsored)?
- Are the microgrants one-time payments or reimbursements?
- Are there specific maintainers we should prioritize (e.g., infra/ops vs. model maintainers)?

I'll loop in Marissa and Aditya to scope from the community fund and see if we can fast-track a small compute voucher.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Community Programs Manager, Redwood Inference

-----
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Modular AI sprint — mentor microgrant request

Marissa / Aditya — Lina asked for 10x $200 microgrants + ~$600 compute pool for their Sept sprint. Attachments include the grant form and budget.

Proposal (quick):
- 8 mentor microgrants @ $200 = $1,600 (targeted to community mentors who actively support maintainers during the sprint)
- $400 compute voucher pool (to be distributed as 50-100 token stipends to maintainers for demo runs)
- Condition: short case study + 1 recorded session acknowledging Redwood support within 30 days post-event.

Rationale: smaller than requested but moves quickly and keeps unit economics reasonable. Lina has promised a quick write-up and social mention.

Any objections? If not, I can confirm with Lina and route the voucher codes.

— Soojin

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Modular AI sprint — mentor microgrant request

Sounds fine to me. A couple of operational notes:
- We should require mentors to fill the short payout form (name, payout handle, preferred method) before funds are distributed.
- For compute vouchers, let's issue 10 codes of $40 each to allow flexible distribution.
- I'll route $2,000 from the community events budget (line 4120) to cover the microgrants + vouchers and tag the spend.

If Aditya is good, Soojin can send the formal approval and I'll set up the payout sheet.

Thanks — M.

Marissa Cole
Head, Developer Programs, Redwood Inference

-----
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Torres <lina@modularai.org>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: Modular AI sprint mentor microgrants

Hi Lina — happy to confirm Redwood will provide:
- 8 mentor microgrants of $200 each (total $1,600)
- 10 compute voucher codes at $40 each (total $400)

Conditions: mentors fill payout sheet prior to issuance; Redwood to receive a short event write-up and one recorded session that acknowledges Redwood support within 30 days post-event.

Please reply with the names/emails of the mentors (or let us know if you prefer to collect and send a single spreadsheet) and confirm whether vouchers should be emailed to maintainers or handed out by your organizers. Once we have that, Marissa will generate codes and process payments.

Congrats on the sprint — excited to support.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Community Programs Manager, Redwood Inference

[Related link: https://drive.redwood/company/modai-sprint/outline]
